cards.text: The LORD is speaking to His people through Joel, son of Pethuel, a prophet (Joel 1:1). He has just promised grain, new wine and oil, and to repay the years the locusts ate, and He said His people will never again be put to shame (Joel 2:19-27). Then He keeps going: 'And afterward,' and friend, in my bakery that means the timer is NOT done yet.

cards.question: After promising all that grain and rain, what does the LORD say He'll pour out next?

cards.text: Way back, Moses, Israel's leader, told his assistant Joshua he wished all the LORD's people were prophets, with the LORD's Spirit on them (Num 11:28-29). Moses made a wish. Here, the LORD says what He WILL do.

cards.question: In Joel, who does the LORD say He'll pour out His Spirit on?
Remember Moses' wish. When the Spirit comes, the LORD says, "Your sons and daughters will ___."

cards.text: Then the LORD says, 'your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.' Me? Years in the back of a junk drawer, and my only dream was somebody yelling, 'HEY, where's the cookie stamper?'

cards.question: In Joel's list, the LORD's Spirit is only for the young, not the old.

cards.text: Then comes one little word: 'Even.' That's the boss saying, 'Everybody gets a bonus, EVEN the new guy,' and the new guy just stands there blinking like, 'Wait. ME?'

cards.question: The LORD adds, "Even on My ___ and ___, I will pour out My Spirit in those days."

cards.text: Now the LORD turns from people to the sky and the ground. He says He will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth.

cards.question: What does the LORD say those wonders in the heavens and on the earth will be?

answers.text: Blood and fire and columns of smoke
Rainbows and doves and gentle rain
Stars and clouds and morning dew

cards.text: Then the sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood. Friend, I lived in the back of a junk drawer for YEARS, I KNOW dark, and even I'm saying, 'Okay. That's a lot.'

cards.question: The sun goes dark and the moon turns to blood. The LORD says those signs come before what?

answers.text: The great and awesome Day of the LORD
The great harvest of the autumn rains
The return of the great locust army

cards.text: Fire, smoke, a dark sun, a blood moon, and then that great and awesome Day. But the LORD doesn't end this on the scary part.

cards.question: With that Day coming, who does the LORD say will be saved?

answers.text: Everyone who calls on the name of the LORD
Everyone who was born inside Jerusalem
Everyone who never broke a single law

cards.question: Joel says there will be deliverance "on Mount ___ and in Jerusalem."
Joel says the deliverance on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem comes as the LORD has promised.

cards.text: And that deliverance is among the remnant called by the LORD. Later, Peter, one of Jesus' apostles, stands up in Jerusalem, says what's happening is what the prophet Joel spoke about, and quotes this very passage (Acts 2:14-21).
